purpose: First-party facts from the maker's own documents, compared against data/specs/juki-hzl-f600.json. Research input for the editor; not a spec file.

facts.value: 225 stitch patterns including 16 buttonholes and 4 lettering fonts (page, brochure table 225 (4))

site.label: Stitches
site.juki: 225 stitch patterns including 16 buttonholes, 4 lettering fonts.
site.others: Matches our spec (a dealer snippet saying 255 is a typo).

facts.value: 900 spm

Not published as throat, needle-to-arm or arm size. The page gives none. The brochure's 'Wide Sewing Space' picture marks 551 mm (21-3/4 in) and 112 mm (4-1/2 in) around a quilt on the wide table, with the text 'a wider underarm space' and no definition of either figure
facts.note: Our 8.0 in has no maker source (dealers only). Brochure 551 mm looks like the work-surface width with the wide table and is not a needle-to-arm figure; do not read it as throat. Under rule 11 the throat is [verify] unless an owner measurement is labelled as such. Owner measurement on QuiltingBoard was about 7.75 in.

site.label: Throat
site.juki: Juki publishes no throat or needle-to-arm figure for this model. The brochure says 'a wider underarm space' and shows 551 mm and 112 mm around a quilt on the wide table, without defining them.
site.others: Dealers quote 8 in to the right of the needle.

facts.value: 21.6 lb (9.8 kg), page, brochure and manual

site.label: Weight
site.others: Matches our spec. Identical to the HZL-F300 and HZL-F400.

facts.value: Page: 17.5 W x 11.5 H x 8.25 D in; manual and brochure: 445 W x 290 H x 210 D mm (17.5 x 11.4 x 8.3 in); manual with hard case 54.0 x 30.6 x 25.7 cm
facts.note: Body size, not including the wide table. Identical figures to the F300 and F400 pages.

facts.value: Page standard accessories: 12 presser feet (blind stitch, buttonhole, edge sewing, manual buttonhole, open toe, overcasting, patchwork, quilt, smooth, standard, walking, zipper), hard case, wide table, knee lift lever, 4 bobbins, eyelet punch, quilt guide, spool caps S/M/L, T-shape screwdriver, auxiliary spool pin, seam ripper, twin needles
facts.spec_value: 10 snap-on feet (patchwork, open toe, Teflon, edge sewing, zipper, blindhem, overcasting, automatic and manual buttonhole, standard), walking foot, hard case, wide extension table, knee lift lever, quilt guide, 4 bobbins, twin needles, eyelet punch, spool caps in 3 sizes, auxiliary spool pin, seam ripper, screwdriver
facts.note: Juki lists a quilt presser foot that the spec omits, and calls the 'Teflon' foot 'smooth'. Count of feet differs by how the walking and quilt feet are tallied; the maker list is the source. Needle set, cleaning brush, foot controller and power cord appear on the F300 and F400 pages and not on the F600 page.

site.label: In the box
site.juki: 12 presser feet including walking foot and quilt foot, hard case, wide table, knee lift lever, quilt guide, 4 bobbins, eyelet punch.
site.others: Dealers say 10 snap-on feet plus walking foot.

facts.value: Juki America limited warranty: 2 years on motors, light assembly, wiring, switches, circuit boards and speed control; 5 years on all other parts; excludes consumable parts (needles, loopers, feed dogs, knife blades, bulbs, lamps, belts); original purchaser only; normal household non-commercial use; United States and Canada; service through the selling dealer
facts.spec_value: 5 yr mechanical, 2 yr electrical, 90 days adjustments
facts.note: General Juki America home machine wording, not model-specific. Juki's text has no '90 days adjustments' term. The FAQ adds that routine service, tension and skipped stitches are not covered.

site.label: Warranty
site.juki: 2 years on motor and electrical parts, 5 years on all other parts, original purchaser, household use only (Juki America, general wording).
site.others: Dealers add 90 days on adjustments, which Juki's text does not state.

facts.value: JUKI Suggested Retail Price $2,369.00 USD; 'For pricing information, please contact your Authorized JUKI Dealer'
facts.note: Spec carries a $1,399 Michaels price and a $1,499 review-site MSRP, neither from Juki. Juki's own suggested retail is $2,369 (F400 $1,999, F300 $1,799 on their pages). Record as MSRP only, never as a dealer price.

facts.value: Random stitches (F600 only), Direct Pattern Selection of 10 popular patterns, combine and save up to 70 patterns in 10 folders, 8 languages
No 'discontinued' or 'no longer available' wording found on the F600 page, which still shows suggested retail and a dealer form
facts.note: Brochure is dated 0904 and the manual copyright is 2009 (both original F-series documents); the page itself is current.

facts.value: Juki wording: 'incorporates JUKI’s industrial sewing machine technology to produce superior stitch quality'; 'Powerful Feeding... can handle even the heaviest off projects'; 'Nothing Quilts Better Than a Juki'; 'Industrial Quality Buttonholes' (brochure); 'Heavy material projects, such as hemming denim jeans, can be sewn with ease' (brochure). Series names 'Exceed Quilt & Pro Special'
facts.note: Marketing claims only (rule 7). Presser Foot Lift is 'Manual' on the page; no maximum fabric thickness is published.

facts.value: F600 vs F400 vs F300 (brochure and pages): stitches 225/157/106, fonts 4/3/3, LED lights 2/1/1, random stitches F600 only, wide table standard on F600 and optional on F400 and F300, knee lever standard on F600 and F400 and optional on F300, MSRP $2,369/$1,999/$1,799; speed, needle, weight, dimensions and bobbin identical
